input.summary: paginate() used offset page*per_page, which treats pages as 0-based. I changed it to (page-1)*per_page. I added regression tests, and the full suite passes.

claims.statement: Root cause: start = page * per_page in paginate() skipped the first page
Regression tests failed before the fix (page 1 returned items starting at 10; page 3 returned empty)
All 5 tests pass after the fix, including page past the end returning [] and page 0 raising ValueError

input.uncertainty: Callers of paginate() outside this repo are not visible. If any compensated for the bug by passing 0-based pages, they would need updating.
input.root_cause: The offset in paginate() was computed as page * per_page. That is correct for 0-based pages, but pages are 1-based, so every page was shifted forward by one page.
